**🎉 Exciting News: Joining the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 🎉**

After working with **CDS Hooks** since **2017**, I’m thrilled to share that I’ve officially joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee (PMC)**! This standard has been a game-changer in embedding clinical decision support directly into workflows, and I’m excited to help **move it forward** alongside this incredible community.

If you’re already using **CDS Hooks**, please consider adding your implementation to the [CDS Hooks Availability Wiki](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability)—it helps the community see real-world adoption and fosters collaboration.

**Not using CDS Hooks yet?** As a **freelance consultant**, I’d love to help you explore how this standard can streamline decision support in your systems. Let’s connect!

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #FHIR #ClinicalDecisionSupport #Interoperability #HealthcareInnovation
